description:
Every delivered call went through a deliver_lanes__* shim (deliver_entry_continuation_for_source, src/compiler2/jobs/native.rs). The shim is a continuation whose body is one TailCall into the __resume_N entry with the same captures, so each continuation built two identical heap frames, and each shim jump spent a reduction. On the distiller 1,312 of 1,326 shims are pure forwarders. When the entry's DeliveredResume layout equals the delivered source layout (the transport plan's settled endpoints, compared as resolve_return_flow already does for Tail), the call site's continuation is the entry continuation itself.
Measured (spike /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/d1d265b3-f8e7-419b-8316-906f89c17e6b/scratchpad/9x7-4/shim-spike.patch on c5a03e198): continuation allocs 74.2M -> 38.1M on the distiller 32k trace; user time 2.86 -> 2.61 s; distiller compile 3.07 -> 1.87 s; binary 6.13 -> 4.94 MB; full trace retired instructions 420.4G (base) -> 407.9G. Peak RSS at a single trace length can be higher or lower: it steps up by 60-100 MB when a major lands, and fewer reductions shift that phase. Over an 11-length sweep (16k-41k lines) mean RSS is 224 MB vs base 237 MB (/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/d1d265b3-f8e7-419b-8316-906f89c17e6b/scratchpad/9x7-gc/notes.md). Young overshoot at collection is ~1% of budget for every variant (hypothesis 'longer quanta overshoot' refuted).
Pins (all from the removed frame or the removed reduction): 01161/01163 3->2, 01164 1024->1015, 01165 rows 3->2 and 6->2, quicksort {103,5408}->{52,2720}, map_atom_order 250->143, a_matched_reply collected yields 25->18, a_large_list yield sizes.
Acceptance: full gate + poison test green; the 14 non-identity shims stay; a test pins one frame per continuation for a delivered call.
title: A call whose result already has its resume entry's layout continues straight into that entry
